name: Ensure that the --seccomp-default parameter is set to true
description: Enable the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile for all workloads that do not specify one.
long_description:
seccomp restricts the system calls a container may make. When seccompDefault is enabled, the kubelet applies the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile to every workload that does not set a profile of its own, rather than running it unconfined. Without it, a workload that omits a seccomp profile has the full system call surface available to it, which widens what an attacker can reach after a container compromise.

CIS marks 4.2.14 as Manual and unscored, and its audit tests only that the parameter is set - on the command line or in the kubelet config - not that it holds a particular value. This control follows that, matching C-0284 (CIS 4.2.13), the adjacent Manual recommendation.
remediation:
Set the parameter, either via the `--seccomp-default` command line argument or the `seccompDefault` setting in the kubelet config file. Setting it to `true` enables the RuntimeDefault profile for workloads that do not declare one.

 Based on your system, restart the `kubelet` service. For example:

 
```
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart kubelet.service

```
manual_test:
Run the following command on each node:

 
```
ps -ef | grep kubelet

```
 Verify that the `--seccomp-default` argument is set.

 If the `--seccomp-default` argument is not present, check that there is a Kubelet config file specified by `--config`, and that the file sets `seccompDefault`.

 If the kubelet is started with `--config-dir`, the effective configuration is the file given by `--config` with the drop-in files from that directory merged over it, applied in lexical order with later files taking precedence. Verify the merged result rather than the base file alone.
impact_statement: Workloads that do not declare a seccomp profile will run under RuntimeDefault. A workload relying on a system call that RuntimeDefault blocks will fail until it declares a profile of its own.
default_value: By default, `--seccomp-default` is not set, which is equivalent to false.
